prompts.initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting game animation sprite sheet. Make exactly sixteen DISTINCT full-body hand-painted anime sprites in a rigid four-column by four-row layout on a square 2048x2048 transparent RGBA canvas, equal 512x512 invisible cells. No text, captions, borders or drawn grid. Image 1 is ONLY a character identity, costume and rendering-style reference. Do not reproduce the background or standing portrait. Create new fully articulated dynamic poses with visibly different arms, torso, hips, knees and sword angles; no duplicates and no merely translated portrait. Same adult character identity, same costume, same camera, same body scale in all sixteen cells, polished Japanese fantasy illustration with crisp readable silhouette and refined highlights. Each pose faces RIGHT at three-quarter side view suitable for a side-view platform fighter, with the face tending toward the right. Within each cell keep the body centered near x=46%, feet baseline at y=88%, head normally y=19%, a character approximately 70% of cell height. Allow room for weapons: contain each figure, every sword tip, cape, and light effect fully inside its own cell with at least 5% transparent padding on every side. Weapon length may use perspective foreshortening to stay inside cell. Background must be genuinely fully alpha transparent, no painted checkerboard, floor, fog, glow backdrop or cast shadow. Visible magic strokes can have translucent alpha and may accompany attack contact poses only. Anatomy must remain consistent and elegant, feet fully visible. Reading order left to right, top to bottom: row 1: combat idle guard, running stride left leg forward, running stride right leg forward, airborne jump with knees lifted. Row 2: light attack anticipation drawing greatsword back, light attack decisive forward slash contact with hips twisted and front knee bent, light attack extended follow-through with sword out ahead, light attack recovery pulling weapon toward guard. Row 3: heavy attack deep crouched overhead wind-up, heavy attack powerful descending contact arc, heavy attack low forward extended follow-through with legs widely braced, heavy attack rising recovery to guard. Row 4: unique elemental skill anticipation, elemental skill release/contact, elemental skill continued full-body follow-through, elemental skill recovery. All four poses of attack/skill rows form real sequential motion. Subject: Diluc, same adult red-haired man in reference with long scarlet hair tied behind, black formal long coat with red inner lining and gold/silver trim, white shirt, black trousers and boots, heavy black and red greatsword. Skill row: flaming greatsword forward rush; anticipation crouches low with greatsword pulled back, release drives forward in a strong deep lunge sweeping a compact orange-red fire blade toward right, continued follow-through a second broad advancing swing with coat and red ponytail streaming backward, recovery brakes with sword low and smoke-free small flame embers. Attack magic is orange red fire. Face/costume visual fidelity to supplied reference.
prompts.layoutAndEffectsFix: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the atlas layout of this 16-pose sprite sheet for production runtime cropping. CRITICAL CORRECTION: each complete figure with its full greatsword and cape must fit strictly inside its own cell with 12% completely transparent empty border on ALL FOUR SIDES. Current source weapons/magic cross cell boundaries; fix this by shrinking the COMPLETE sprite (person AND weapon together proportionally) inside each 512x512 cell, re-centering each pose. In particular the horizontally thrust sword in row 2 col 3 must be fully contained in col 3, never enter col 4. The skill poses in row 4 must also be independent with transparent gaps between them. Do not add grid lines, visible boxes, divider marks, captions, text, floors, backgrounds, shadows, or checkerboard. Genuine alpha transparency. Preserve sixteen different articulated poses and the same sequence as input; do not merge cells.
